```{python}
import numpy as np
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

from pyslingshot import Slingshot
import scanpy as sc
```

```{python}
carpall = sc.read("carpall_scvi_integrated.h5ad")
sc.pl.umap(carpall, color="leiden_res_0.7", legend_loc="on data")
to_remove = ["18", "19", "20", "8"]
carpall = carpall[~carpall.obs["leiden_res_0.7"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
sc.pl.umap(carpall, color="leiden_res_0.7")
```

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=2, ncols=2, figsize=(10, 10))
custom_xlim = (-12, 12)
custom_ylim = (-12, 12)
# plt.setp(axes, xlim=custom_xlim, ylim=custom_ylim)
start_node = list(carpall.obs["leiden_res_0.7"].cat.categories).index("0")
slingshot = Slingshot(carpall, celltype_key="leiden_res_0.7", obsm_key="X_umap", start_node=start_node, is_debugging="verbose")

slingshot.fit(num_epochs=1, debug_axes=axes)
```
